Attica chips and onion dip.d: Ridged and salty, with onions cooked slow till brown in sour cream, cream cheese and chives.
Attica chips and onion dip.note: One big bowl for the counter.

Deli hero wedges.d: Ham, salami, provolone, iceberg and tomato, oil, vinegar, oregano, on long rolls. Pressed.

Hostage pizza.d: Thin crust, crushed tomato and oregano, plenty of mozzarella, baked fast in a very hot oven.
Hostage pizza.note: Two at 3.10. Pay the kid at the door.

Italian ice.d: Fresh juice and zest, sugar and water, frozen and scraped fluffy.
Italian ice.note: A dozen cups. Not for Mr. Mulvaney.

Heatwave lager with lime and chilli salt.d: Lager over ice with a fresh squeeze, the glass dipped in salt and chili powder.
